engine_default_path: BPSK/QPSK only; 8PSK and 16-QAM are EXPERIMENTAL and off by default (Constitution §24 row 34), so the burst_8PSK_* and burst_16QAM_* classes are expected to be refused and carry no recall criterion
protocol: Committed BEFORE the SEALED split was ever generated or run (Constitution §18.1). Thresholds come from the CALIBRATION split with margin and were then sanity-checked against the TRAIN split, which is what TRAIN is for; version 2 records one revision made at that point and nothing after. A criterion is a falsifiable statement about the sealed measurement, not a description of it.

no_false_accept_on_non_catalogue_signals.requirement: ≤ 1% of null-class files DECODED, and the 95% Wilson upper bound ≤ 5%
no_false_accept_on_non_catalogue_signals.why: This is the property the whole evidence-first design exists to protect (α = 0.01 per file, §13.1). A failure here invalidates the engine's claims, not just its recall.

wrong_structure_or_payload_is_rare.requirement: ≤ 2% of catalogue-class files DECODED with a wrong structure or a wrong payload
wrong_structure_or_payload_is_rare.why: A partially correct claim (a true statement about fewer layers, or a block code that decoded some of its codewords) is counted separately and is not a failure; this bounds claims that are actually wrong.

continuous_stream_code_recall.requirement: ≥ 80% of continuous K7 streams at Es/N0 ≥ 6 dB fully decoded

ccsds_concatenated_chain_recall.requirement: ≥ 60% of CCSDS concatenated captures at Es/N0 ≥ 9 dB decoded fully to the RS payload

tc_ldpc_cltu_recall.requirement: ≥ 80% of TC LDPC CLTUs at Es/N0 ≥ 6 dB decoded

rs_framed_recall.requirement: ≥ 50% of framed RS captures at Es/N0 ≥ 9 dB decoded to the RS payload

blind_framed_signal_no_code.requirement: ≥ 50% of non-catalogue framed streams reported as SIGNAL_NO_CODE with the true frame period

burst_block_interleaver_recall.requirement: ≥ 50% of BPSK/QPSK block-interleaved bursts at Es/N0 ≥ 12 dB fully decoded

ccsds_concatenated_chain_not_wrong.requirement: ≥ 85% of CCSDS concatenated captures at Es/N0 ≥ 9 dB answered without a wrong claim (full or partial decode)

known_limitations_not_under_test: 8PSK and 16-QAM bursts: the default path does not search them (EXPERIMENTAL, §24 row 34); eval/higher_mod_sweep.py measures that path separately.
Convolutional (Forney) interleaver recall is low and is measured, not required: the hypothesis has no block length of its own, so it is sized by the receiver's filter ring-out.
Low Es/N0 bursts (3–6 dB) are expected to be refused; §18 records the same behaviour on bench-v1.

revision_history.change: initial thresholds from the calibration split

ccsds_concatenated_chain_recall lowered from 0.80 to 0.60 full decodes and paired with a new criterion ccsds_concatenated_chain_not_wrong (>= 0.85 full or partial). Reason: on the TRAIN split 9/12 captures at Es/N0 >= 9 dB decoded fully and 2 of the 3 remaining were honest partial RS decodes under CFO drift and Rician fading (2/4 and 12/16 codewords), which the single full-decode criterion counted as misses. The pair now states both properties instead of one that conflates them. Revised before SEALED existed; no sealed measurement informed it.
